_comment: Synced by .github/workflows/labels.yml on merge. The sync creates and updates and never deletes. `claude: true` marks the labels the weekly upkeep run may add.

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Good for newcomers: small, settled, checkable

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Design settled, open to an outside contributor

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: Labelled by a maintainer or the weekly upkeep run

labels.name: claude-proposed
labels.description: Filed by the weekly upkeep run. Scope not yet confirmed

labels.name: upkeep-log
labels.description: The weekly upkeep run's log issue

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

labels.name: area:content
labels.description: Blog posts, dev logs and page copy

labels.name: area:3d
labels.description: Three.js scenes, models and the globe
